answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Licensed building surveyor inspection report with building surveyors verification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 679 aliases need 679 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. The lagoon sits in the mechanism itself, the beacon sits in the price of faking it, and the meadow sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
